//: Type-checks the init scripts injected into every page.
These are plain .js and deliberately stay that way: they are read from the
wheel at runtime, templated, and injected as strings, so compiling them
would add a build artifact that can drift from its source for files that
run inside every page octowright drives. checkJs gets the type safety with
no build step and nothing new to ship.
noEmit is not merely set, it is the whole contract: this config must never
produce output next to the sources it reads.
